name: app.drawsql/mcp
title: DrawSQL
description: Turn SQL into an editable ER diagram link. With an API token, read diagrams and propose changes.

tools.name: visualize_schema
tools.description: Create an interactive, editable DrawSQL entity-relationship diagram from a database schema. Return a shareable drawsql.app/draw link.

ddl.description: SQL CREATE TABLE and ALTER TABLE statements. Provide either this field or `schema`, but not both.

schema.description: A DrawSQL schema patch encoded as a JSON string. Top-level keys: tables, relationships, groups, sticky_notes. Example: {"tables":[{"name":"users","columns":[{"name":"id","type":"bigint"}]},{"name":"posts","columns":[{"name":"id","type":"bigint"},{"name":"user_id","type":"bigint"}],"parent_name":"Content"}],"relationships":[{"type":"one-to-many","source_table":"users","source_column":"id","target_table":"posts","target_column":"user_id"}],"groups":[{"name":"Content"}],"sticky_notes":[{"content":"Draft"}]}. Relationship types: one-to-one, one-to-many, many-to-one (hyphenated). Identifiers (names, uuids, references) match exactly: no leading/trailing whitespace or control characters, table and group names unique, uuids unique across the whole patch, and entries repeating a uuid must repeat its name. Full format: https://drawsql.app/llms-full.txt. Provide either this field or `ddl`, but not both.

driver.description: Database dialect, one of: mysql, pgsql, sqlsrv. Defaults to mysql.
